messages.subject: fitqtl:error, system is computationally singular
parts:
Dear all,
I am trying to compute a multiple qtl model using makeqtl() and fitqtl(). I got an issue with a trait for which I got seven qtls. Do anyone knows how to deal with with issue?
Thank you in advance for you help.
Best regards
Angovy

>myFormula <- y~Q1+Q2+Q3+Q4+Q5+Q6+Q7
>fitqtl(norwManData,pheno.col="dvern",qtl,formula=myFormula,method="hk",get.ests=TRUE)
Error in solve.default(t(Z) %*% Z, t(Z) %*% X) :
  system is computationally singular: reciprocal condition number = 2.55266e-17
In addition: Warning message:
In fitqtlengine(pheno = pheno, qtl = qtl, covar = covar, formula = formula,  :
  Dropping 3 individuals with missing phenotypes.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] fitqtl:error, system is computationally singular
parts:
The model is over-specified; probably you'll need to reduce the number of QTL.

if you call fitqtl with get.ests=FALSE but dropone=TRUE, is there any indication that there might be problems (for example, QTL with LOD=0 in the drop-one-qtl table)?

karl

messages.subject: Re: fitqtl:error, system is computationally singular
parts:
Dear Karl,
Thank you for your answer.
1) The model consisted of 7 QTLs because mqmscan revealed 7 QTLs for the trait. My idea using fitqtl is to get the overall variance explained by those 7 QTLs. I tried to drop one qtl manually and I found that one of the qtl (lod 3.62) is reponsible of the algo failure, even if the model include only 2 qtls.
2) Another trait is controlled by 3 QTLs and the model with all of the 3 QTLs together generated the same error. Here again, only one qtl (lod 5) caused the problem.
I think removing a qtl (lod being significant) from the model will result in an underestimate of the variance explained. Getting simply rid of such qtl is that the only thing I can do for this issue?
Thank you in advance for your suggestion.
Angovy
